## Keep signed attachment offers out of argv

Signed attachment offers are reusable plaintext capabilities. This release adds stdin input for downloads so plugins and shell users no longer need to place those capabilities in process arguments.

### Safer download example

```sh
printf '%s' '<signed-offer>' \
  | meshmsg download --offer-stdin --output ./received-report.pdf
```

`--offer-stdin` follows the same capability-input behavior as `meshmsg join --token-stdin`:

- reads through EOF as UTF-8;
- accepts a signed meshmsg offer or raw Iroh BlobTicket;
- removes one final LF and an optional preceding CR;
- enforces a 1 MiB input limit;
- conflicts with the positional offer argument.

Positional downloads remain supported for compatibility:

```sh
meshmsg download '<signed-offer>' --output ./received-report.pdf
```

Using stdin prevents argv and shell-history disclosure. It does not encrypt the offer or attachment: anyone who obtains the signed offer can reuse it to fetch the plaintext content while the provider remains available.

### Install

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or install this exact release from source:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg.git \
  --tag v0.1.9 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.8...v0.1.9
